introduction: 211 Virginia connects residents with local housing, food, health and community services. Check current live assistance hours before calling.
description: 211 Virginia connects residents with local housing, food, health and community services. Check current live assistance hours before calling.

sections.who: People seeking resources can use the service. Individual providers separately set eligibility and available support.
sections.get: The directory and navigation service provide referrals; they do not approve the referred benefit.

sections.apply:
1. Choose a contact method

    Dial 211, text CONNECT to 247211, or use chat or search at 211 Virginia.

  2. Describe the need

    Explain your immediate problem and location.

  3. Check the referral

    Ask providers about intake, documents and current availability.
sections.after: The current pilot limits live staffing hours, while search and Agentless Assist remain available outside those hours.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using 211 Virginia; Current live-hours pilot. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: The public directory and Agentless Assist remain available.
